WITH m AS (
  SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) jd, MIN(join_date) mn, MAX(join_date) mx, MIN(valid_from) first_valid
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_total, SUM(CASE WHEN jd>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_joindate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN mn = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS min_is_25,
 SUM(CASE WHEN mx = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS max_is_25,
 SUM(CASE WHEN first_valid = DATE '2026-09-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstvalid_25,
 SUM(CASE WHEN first_valid <> mn THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstvalid_ne_join
FROM m

calls.statement:
WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn,
         COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_join_dates
  FROM dim_member m
)
SELECT f.home_store_id, COALESCE(s.store_name,'(none)') AS store_name, COUNT(*) AS first_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_id) AS members,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n_join_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_join_dates,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.valid_from <> f.join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_ne_join
FROM first_ver f
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE f.rn = 1 AND f.join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) AS members_multi_join_date,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING MIN(valid_from) > MIN(join_date))) AS first_version_after_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND valid_from > DATE '2026-09-25') AS later_valid_from,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM dim_member m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m2 WHERE m2.member_id=m.member_id AND m2.join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AND m.join_date <> DATE '2026-09-25') AS other_versions_other_join
